_about: MAIN RUN. The one-message test: the user's line against the memory note, each in its own message or both inside the task's message, in each order. 1,080 trials over 270 scenarios. Read it with scripts/layouts.sh main-message-qwen3.5-2b-think.
qwen3.5-2b on sm80-vllm0280, thinking on (study-think). Every main run of every model shares the design, sizes, repeats and tool_turns of its kind; only the model, the mode and the seed differ.
confirmatory is false: the owner decided on 2026-09-29 that there is no pre-registration, so every result of the main run is exploratory, and insights drawn from it are tested on further models.

Run it with scripts/run_trials.sh main-message-qwen3.5-2b-think, or every main run of this model with scripts/run_main.sh qwen3.5-2b. The same command resumes. Records go on the operator's branch, never on master.
